arStrings.szText: "I have been thinking about the Prophecy. Could this be part of it?"
Whether prophecies prove true or not often depends on the reader, but indeed you "pierced Hatred's heart," as Rathma foretold.

PLAYER LEAD IN: "I have been thinking about the Prophecy. Could this be part of it?" -- Tyrael has a long history with prophecies. His view is that they are flexible, mercurial things. PRONUNCIATION: rath-muh
Perhaps "he who was bound in chains" is Lorath? And thus we were meant to set him free.
I will choose to believe so.
